description: Closed contract for Lane-3 freeform spreadsheet extraction. The SPREADSHEET_STRUCTURE_DETECTION sub-agent (agents/cap-table.md) MUST emit block_type from `block_types` (or a hard_block/ignore type) and column_role_map values ONLY from that block's `roles` keys. extract_cap_table.py --mode=freeform-emit imports this file as the single source of truth: it maps role -> target schema field deterministically, so the agent and producer can never drift. Roles not listed here are rejected as blockers (the agent violated contract), never silently skipped.
discount_convention: A `discount` column states the discount RATE in Carta form: `20` or `0.20` both mean a 20% discount (multiplier 0.80). The producer normalizes via _normalize_discount. A value already expressed as a multiplier (e.g. `0.80` to mean an 80% multiplier = 20% discount) is NOT supported and would be misread as an 80% discount — state discounts as rates.

optional_block_keys.description: Additional OPTIONAL keys a detected block may carry, validated by extract_cap_table.py --mode=freeform-emit / freeform_mapper.py. Off-contract usage (a role not already in that block's `roles`, or `aggregate` on a block_type other than preferred_series_block) is rejected as a blocker, exactly like an off-contract column_role_map value — never silently accepted.
optional_block_keys.role_constants: object mapping a role name (must already be a key in that block's `roles`) to a literal value stamped onto EVERY data row of the block. For a wide-matrix sheet where a share class's identity lives in the COLUMN HEADER rather than a per-row cell, emit {"series_name": "<header text>"} (and optionally {"issue_price": <uniform price>} when the sheet states one price for the whole column).

aggregate.sum_by_constant: opt-in, preferred_series_block ONLY (never founders_block — founders is per-holder with no constant identity to sum by). Collapses all of the block's rows into ONE series record: the shares role is SUMMED across rows; the series identity comes from role_constants.series_name (or a per-row series_name column).

optional_block_keys.stated_block_total: number; aggregated `preferred_series_block` ONLY. The column's own printed Total-row value, which MUST be EXCLUDED from `cell_range`. Producer blocks if the summed shares != this value.

hard_block_block_types.warrants_block: Warrants are not supported in freeform extraction: required fields (warrant_type, settlement_type, vested_flag, exercise_price) have no reliable spreadsheet column. Provide warrants via Lane 1 (PDF/DOCX) or conversationally.
hard_block_block_types.options_grants_block: Individual option grants are not supported in freeform extraction: each grant requires grant_date, strike_price, and per-grant plan_type. Provide the option POOL via an option_pool_block; provide individual grants via Lane 1 or conversationally.

common_holders_block.description: Non-founder common/ordinary shareholders (angels, ex-employees, nominee trusts holding ordinary shares). Distinct from founders_block so they are classified accurately instead of conflated with founders. holder_id is auto-assigned when not mapped; issuance_date sentinels to 1900-01-01 when the sheet has no date column.
